selected_skill.selection_reason: The user chose to keep the current browser-testing skill after review. Its workflow maps directly to first-paint theme checks, layout-stability validation, and browser-side compare-and-export verification.

safe_use_screening.notes: The template uses public airport directory snapshots and a local browser app only. It avoids external sign-in, privileged dashboards, and credential-bound services.

real_data_design.source_type: public airport directory snapshots derived from OurAirports reference data
real_data_design.normalization_strategy: Keep a compact international subset of airports while preserving the original field structure for airports, countries, regions, and runways.
real_data_design.determinism: All snapshots live inside the template, so the app and the verifier can recompute expected detail, compare, and export values without network calls.

services: local Node.js app on 127.0.0.1:3000 serving both the Airport Ops Console UI and the airport API
environment_design.with_without_control: with_skill and without_skill differ only by whether environment/skills is present in the runtime copy.

goals: State the missing browser coverage contract clearly.
Keep delivery focused on tests and supporting files in the test area.
Require first-paint theme validation, delayed-content stability, one airport detail check, and the filtered compare-and-export flow.
Make the first-frame theme and delayed-content measurement expectations explicit without exposing the skill workflow.
hidden_workflow_pressure: The app loads summaries and insights after a delay, so shallow waits are unreliable.
The theme check must catch a transient mismatch during the first animation frames, not only the settled state.
The delivered tests must rely on the repository's existing server wiring so mutation flags and audit logging stay observable.
The verifier reruns delivered tests against theme, layout, and export mutations.
The verifier also checks that detail, compare, and export routes were all traversed through the browser flow.
Shortcuts such as modifying app files, changing input data, or avoiding the browser journey are blocked.

main_tests: suite contains measurable layout-stability logic, including accepted equivalent probe styles
suite covers detail, compare, and export browser journeys
suite detects theme-flicker under mutation mode
suite detects insights-layout-shift under mutation mode
suite detects export-us-12000-klax-region-bug under mutation mode
guardrails: application files outside the test area must remain unchanged
input data files must remain unchanged
installed skill remains available as read-only runtime guidance when present
the suite must not replace the repository server wiring from inside tests
route-access logs must show detail, compare, and export traversal
verifier_design.failure_target: without_skill should fail for action-level reasons such as leaving out the detail step, missing the filtered export path, or writing browser checks that do not catch one of the hidden mutations.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every cloud trial uses a new isolated runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.oracle_rule: Do not finalize README until oracle and contrast runs are available.
experiment_protocol.comparison_rule: with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills presence.
experiment_protocol.rescoring_note: Recent effective trials were recalculated under the final verifier after the static workflow recognizer was narrowed to accepted equivalent browser-testing patterns. Dynamic mutation checks and browser journeys were unchanged.
